artifact: Decrypted MIDI file from the 2012/009 MIDI puzzle archive
authentication: The outer clear-signed email is cryptographically verified against the preserved Cicada 2012 public key (key ID 181F01E57A35090F). This authenticates the signed instruction and embedded encrypted-message block relative to that key, not the real-world identity of its controller. The decrypted song.mid is a participant-archive artifact and is not separately signed.
notes: The README documents two GPG decryptions from midi.asc to song.mid. The timing-gate parser verifies the exact Git blob SHA-1 before parsing. The 49-word submission list is recipient-specific.
